name: ctf-security
description: Tool-first CTF triage and local capability routing for Codex

interface.shortDescription: Use local CTF tools before writing solver scripts
interface.longDescription: CTF first-step router, artifact profiler, local capability audit, and structured human-action requests for RE, pwn, crypto, misc, and web challenges.
interface.defaultPrompt: For every CTF task, call ctf_tool_audit first. Prefer /home/source/tools/PyVenv/CTF/bin/python and its installed modules, use mcp-chrome for interactive browser work, use Tavily MCP for CVE/version research, and use the configured IDA MCP instead of requiring IDA CLI. Write a new script only after the audit and available MCPs leave a concrete gap; use ctf_mcp_configure when only a key such as TAVILY_API_KEY is needed.
